message.content:
To retrieve the CNAME records for **sample.com** via VirusTotal API v3, make a GET request to:

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?type=CNAME
```

Include your API key in the `x-apikey` header:

```
x-apikey: secret123
```

The JSON response will contain an array of DNS‑record objects.  
Each object has an `"id"` field – those are the IDs you’re looking for.
